summary: Translated the starterset "HOW TO USE THIS MODULE" page (1/1 chunk, byte range 0–6418) into Chinese. Register is instructional GM-facing how-to, not read-aloud — no evblockquoteCenter/evexamplebox in this unit. Boilerplate shared with the system pack's MU/TH/ER page was matched to the already-shipped 1-系统汉化插件/compendium/cn/alienrpg.alien-rpg-system.json phrasing byte-for-byte, not re-invented: the whole "Recommended Add-on Modules" block (推荐附加模块 / Dice So Nice / Quick Insert / Motion Tracker), the whole "Macros" block (宏 / 它们在合集里的 Macro>Alien 下 …"Import All Content"…), and all four macro names taken from that pack's macros map (异形 -  GM 投骰器 with the two-space form, 异形 - 玩家临时 YZE 投骰器, 异形 - 在选定的老妈表格上投骰 V10, 异形 - 在选定的生物表格上投骰 V10). The @UUID label was set to MU/TH/ER 使用说明 — verified byte-equal to the JournalEntry name the system cn pack actually ships, which the DO-NOT-TRANSLATE register lists as T-SHIMMED (translated_to: "MU/TH/ER 使用说明") with the shim file present on disk; the UUID machinery is untouched. Navigation literals a GM must find in the sidebar (folder / scene / journal names) were left in English so the page still points at real targets whatever ST-U decides for those names. All 3 NBSPs around the chat-roll span preserved, straight ASCII apostrophe in "Hope's Last Day" preserved (an earlier draft had a curly one — caught and fixed), &/> entity counts unchanged, all style= values unchanged.

glossary_gaps.why: Not in glossary_alien.json and not in lang/cn.json. It is a Foundry/TRPG staging concept, quoted in the English as a scene-design note. 心灵剧场 is the common Chinese TRPG rendering; 脑内剧场 and 意象剧场 also circulate. Used once, consistently. Needs a ruling before other units hit it.
Not in glossary_alien.json. It is a Foundry scene feature, not an Alien rules term; 战争迷雾 is Foundry's own zh convention. Expanded the acronym in Chinese since FoW would read as noise.

The starter-set scenario title (Hadley's Hope / LV-426). No glossary entry, no RULINGS entry, and the two delivered peer units disagree: ST-J02 has 《希望的最后一天》, ST-J03 has 《希望的最后一日》. I used 最后一天 to match ST-J02 and the literal Day. Needs a ruling — it also decides whether ST-U gives the journal/folder a bilingual name.
glossary_alien.json has Air Duct 通风道 but not the bare 'duct'. Used 通风道 for consistency with that entry; flagging so the creature/stealth units (Drones in the vents) do not drift to 管道/风管.

open_issues: PEER DIVERGENCE — scenario title. ST-J02.cn.html says 《希望的最后一天》, ST-J03.cn.html says 《希望的最后一日》. I went with 最后一天 (ST-J02, and the literal reading of Day). One of the three files needs a sweep once the controller rules. Cheap to fix now, expensive after ST-J07..J10 land.

NAMING DEPENDENCY on ST-U. Every folder/scene/journal name this page tells the GM to click (Alien RPG Mother Aids, ToM - Meeting Room, Alien Evolved, Alien RPG Weapons, Alien RPG Talents(Career), Hope's Last Day - Personal Agendas, Starter Set Rules, Alien Evolved Starter Set Rules) is decided in ST-U, whose English payload currently identity-maps them all. I deliberately kept the English literal as the primary token: it survives whether ST-U ships English or T-BILINGUAL 中文 English, because the bilingual form keeps the English tail. If ST-U instead ships pure Chinese names, this page needs a re-sweep — that is the one outcome my choice does not cover.

MACRO NAMES intentionally do NOT track this page's English. The prose here says 'Alien - GM Dice Roller' (one space) but the actual system macro is 'Alien -  GM Dice Roller' (two spaces), and the system cn pack renames all four. I used the shipped Chinese names in the shipped two-space form so a GM can actually find them in the compendium — matching the system cn how-to page byte-for-byte rather than this page's English. Same reasoning as the @UUID label.

IMPORT BUTTON deliberately left generic. lang/cn.json has ALIENRPG.forceImportLabel = 导入模块内容 / forceImportName = 重新运行模块导入, which would have been a tempting lock. I did not use them: those localise the SYSTEM's re-import setting, while this sentence points at the starterset MODULE's own settings button, which our lang file does not localise. Wrote 单击其中的导入按钮 so the page does not name a label the user will not see. No lock claimed on those two keys.

UPSTREAM DEFECT (carried faithfully, not fixed) — the Journals section ends '…Chariot Of the Gods - Scenario Folder contains:' and then nothing follows. Chariot of the Gods is a separate product with no content in this pack, so the sentence dangles in English too. Translated as-is; do not let a later reviewer 'fix' it by inventing a list.

UPSTREAM DEFECT (carried faithfully) — 'all the agenda items' has no space or punctuation after the closing tag. I inserted a Chinese 、comma-equivalent (，) after so the Chinese reads, which is a punctuation-only deviation from the English's missing space.

NOT VERIFIED — whether any data-hash elsewhere in the starterset pack points at this page's eight slugs. The register measures 81 data-hash occurrences / 44 distinct in starterset but does not list which. I added explicit English-slug ids to all eight headings regardless, so any such link keeps resolving; this is belt-and-braces, not a measured need.
